selector.rationale: Violaceous cutaneous lesions and nodular thickening of nerve roots support BPDCN with polyradiculopathy, which is further confirmed by the presence of 98% atypical cells/blasts in the cerebrospinal fluid analysis

rejected.label: Leptomeningeal disease
rejected.why: Lack of specific findings in the cerebrospinal fluid analysis and imaging studies that are unique to leptomeningeal disease

rejected.label: Neurolymphomatosis
rejected.why: Insufficient evidence of lymphomatous involvement in the central nervous system

rejected.label: Cauda equina syndrome
rejected.why: While some findings are consistent with cauda equina syndrome, they are not specific and are better explained by BPDCN with polyradiculopathy
